newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan foreign reserve figures delayed.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan foreign reserve figures delayed.

text.p: Venezuela's Central Bank did not publish Friday its usual bulletin of macroeconomic statistics, including recent foreign exchange figures, citing technical problems.
"We don't have any information as yet when the figures will become available ... there's probably been some technical problems," a Central Bank spokeswoman told Reuters.
According to Bank figures released last Friday, gross reserves rose $35 million, or 0.2 percent, in the two weeks to Feb. 17 to $15.675 billion.
